name: Datawrapper
description: Datawrapper is a powerful tool for creating charts, maps, and tables from your data, making it easy to visualize and share insights. It is designed to help users transform raw data into clear, engaging visualizations that can be embedded in websites or shared across platforms.

events.d: Create a chart with a title and type, add data and metadata (intro, byline, source, notes, number format), choose a theme and placement (workspace, folder, or organization), and optionally customize visualization…
Find charts by ID, title, or filters, with optional pagination.
Get a user by ID or list workspace/team members, with optional search, role filters, ordering, and pagination.
List members of a workspace team, with optional search, role or invite filters, ordering, and pagination.
Retrieve folders in a workspace, optionally filtering by workspace (slug or name) or by folder name or ID.
Delete a chart permanently or move it to trash (recoverable for 30 days).
List workspaces or retrieve a specific workspace by slug from the connected account.
Create a folder to organize your charts, maps, and tables.
Create a workspace to organize charts, maps, and tables.
Update a chart's title, theme, type, data source, publication settings, metadata, author, folder, and other properties.
Upload CSV or JSON to an existing chart as its data file; the chart ID is used for the filename.
Retrieve themes, optionally filtered by workspace, name, or ID; supports pagination and including deleted items.
List teams in a workspace.
Publish a chart so it's live and ready to embed or share.
Remove a published chart from public view.
Make a copy of a chart.
Check whether a chart is published and get its publish version and status.
Get responsive and static embed codes for a chart.
Get a chart's data as JSON or CSV.
Export a chart as PNG, PDF, or SVG and return a downloadable file URL.

events.n: When a chart is created or updated
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any chart is created or updated in the account.
